scoring_justification: The main numerical results (m_sQ, E_diff) are reported by the agent; the verifier cannot fully recompute them from raw artifacts because re-running the full VMC simulation is infeasible in the checker sandbox. We therefore compare the agent's reported values to the paper's reference numbers with tolerances (T0 result-level compare), classified here as a structural consistency check.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for m_sQ and E_diff at U/t=7,8,9,10 derived from paper Figures 2 and 3
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper figures, approximated to match reference solution
hidden_assets.generation_method: estimated from Figure 3 (m_sQ) and Figure 2 (E_diff) in the source paper, with small adjustments for consistency with the oracle solve.sh
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These values correspond to the paper's own published data in the figures, ensuring the checker verifies reproduction of the paper's main result.

outputs.description: Ordered magnetic moment and energy difference between antiferromagnetic and paramagnetic states for U/t = 7, 8, 9, 10.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker will compare the reported values against the paper's own reference numbers with appropriate tolerances.
